Create one complete FACS ACTION UNITS reference sheet as a flat 7x7 contact sheet, 49 equal portrait tiles. Use a portrait 3:4 or 4:5 canvas; 9:16 is acceptable only if the 7x7 board fills the image. No perspective, no rounded cards, no decorative frames, no thick white gutters, no outer margin, no watermark, no logo. Use thin dark separators or no visible gutters. Each cell must contain one centered medium close-up portrait in the upper 75% of the cell, with a small readable AU code and name in a narrow bottom label band. Subject lock:

. Same character identity, face structure, hairstyle, lens, crop, lighting and background in every tile; only the facial action changes. Critical gaze disambiguation: AU61 Eyes Turn Left means both pupils move toward image-left / viewer-left, not anatomical left; AU62 Eyes Turn Right means both pupils move toward image-right / viewer-right. AU61 and AU62 must be visibly opposite gaze directions and must never look the same way. Use these 49 tiles in this exact left-to-right, top-to-bottom order:
head turns toward subject left into a three-quarter view
head turns toward subject right into a three-quarter view
head tilts toward the subject left shoulder
medium close-up portrait, soft frontal key light, neutral studio background, consistent lens and crop across every tile
